@@ -640,13 +640,26 @@ async def register_catalog_server(
                 # First-Party
                 from mcpgateway.db import Gateway as DbGateway  # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
 
-                # Carry any OAuth credentials the caller supplied (issuer, scopes, and
-                # optionally client_id/client_secret/token_url/authorization_url) onto the
-                # gateway up front, so a second PUT /gateways/{id} is never required (#5967).
+                # Start with catalog OAuth defaults and apply caller overrides.
+                # Persist the result up front so registration needs no second PUT /gateways/{id}.
                 # Whatever is left blank (client_id/secret, token/authorization URLs) is filled
                 # in later - automatically for providers that support discovery/DCR - by the
                 # existing GET /oauth/authorize/{gateway_id} flow.
-                gateway_data["oauth_config"] = self._build_oauth_config_from_credentials(request.oauth_credentials if request else None)
+                # Blank submitted values (None, "", [] - e.g. optional URL fields the web form sends
+                # empty) must not mask a non-empty catalog default, so drop them before merging.
+                submitted_credentials = {k: v for k, v in ((request.oauth_credentials if request else None) or {}).items() if v not in (None, "", [])}
+                catalog_oauth = dict(server_data.get("oauth") or {})
+                # A submitted issuer that differs from the catalog one names another authorization server,
+                # so the catalog endpoints (which belong to the catalog issuer) must not be paired with it.
+                if submitted_credentials.get("issuer") and submitted_credentials["issuer"] != catalog_oauth.get("issuer"):
+                    catalog_oauth.pop("authorization_url", None)
+                    catalog_oauth.pop("token_url", None)
+                # Without a client_id, an issuer routes /oauth/authorize through DCR; skip the catalog
+                # issuer for providers that do not support it so they keep failing on the missing client_id.
+                if catalog_oauth.get("supports_dcr") is False and not submitted_credentials.get("client_id") and "issuer" not in submitted_credentials:
+                    catalog_oauth.pop("issuer", None)
+                oauth_credentials = {**catalog_oauth, **submitted_credentials}
+                gateway_data["oauth_config"] = self._build_oauth_config_from_credentials(oauth_credentials)
 
                 # Runs the same URL/SSRF and grant-type validation normal gateway registration
                 # applies (GatewayCreate.validate_oauth_config); oauth_config round-trips through

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("credentials", [{}, {"resource": "https://mcp.linear.app/custom"}])
+def test_catalog_resource_preserves_path(credentials: dict) -> None:
+    """Registration preserves the catalog resource path and accepts caller overrides."""
+    response = _register("linear", {"oauth_credentials": credentials})
+    if response.status_code == 404:
+        pytest.skip(f"catalog 'linear' entry unavailable: {response.text}")
+    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
+    payload = response.json()
+    assert payload["success"] is True, payload
+    server_id = payload["server_id"]
+    try:
+        gateway_response = httpx.get(f"{BASE_URL}/v1/gateways/{server_id}", headers=_headers(), timeout=10.0)
+        assert gateway_response.status_code == 200, gateway_response.text
+        oauth_config = gateway_response.json().get("oauthConfig") or {}
+        assert oauth_config.get("resource") == credentials.get("resource", "https://mcp.linear.app/mcp")
+        assert oauth_config.get("scopes") == ["read", "write"]
+    finally:
+        _delete_gateway(server_id)

+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "credentials",
+    [
+        None,
+        {},
+        {"resource": "https://override.example.com/mcp", "scopes": ["custom"]},
+        {"authorization_url": "", "token_url": None, "scopes": []},
+    ],
+)
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_register_oauth_uses_catalog_defaults(service, credentials):
+    """Registration preserves catalog OAuth defaults and applies caller overrides."""
+    fake_catalog = {"catalog_servers": [{"id": "oauth-server", "name": "OAuth Server", "url": "https://oauth.example.com/mcp", "description": "OAuth server", "auth_type": "OAuth2.1", "tags": []}]}
+
+    defaults = {
+        "resource": "https://oauth.example.com/mcp",
+        "issuer": "https://issuer.example.com",
+        "authorization_url": "https://issuer.example.com/authorize",
+        "token_url": "https://issuer.example.com/token",
+        "scopes": ["read", "write"],
+        "audience": "https://api.example.com",
+        "redirect_uri": "https://gateway.example.com/oauth/callback",
+    }
+    fake_catalog["catalog_servers"][0]["oauth"] = dict(defaults)
+    request = CatalogServerRegisterRequest(server_id="oauth-server", oauth_credentials=credentials) if credentials is not None else None
+
+    with patch.object(service, "load_catalog", AsyncMock(return_value=fake_catalog)):
+        db = MagicMock()
+        db.execute.return_value.scalar_one_or_none.return_value = None
+
+        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
+
+        def mock_refresh(obj):
+            obj.id = "test-id"
+            obj.created_at = now
+            obj.updated_at = now
+            obj.reachable = False
+
+        db.refresh = MagicMock(side_effect=mock_refresh)
+
+        with patch("mcpgateway.services.catalog_service.select"), patch("mcpgateway.services.catalog_service.slugify", return_value="oauth-server"):
+            result = await service.register_catalog_server("oauth-server", request, db, created_by="u@x.com", owner_email="u@x.com", token_teams=None)
+
+    assert result.oauth_required is True
+    db_gateway = db.add.call_args[0][0]
+    assert result.success is True
+    submitted = {k: v for k, v in (credentials or {}).items() if v not in (None, "", [])}
+    for key, value in {**defaults, **submitted}.items():
+        assert db_gateway.oauth_config[key] == value
+    assert fake_catalog["catalog_servers"][0]["oauth"] == defaults
+
+
+async def _register_oauth_with_catalog(service, catalog_oauth, credentials):

+    request = CatalogServerRegisterRequest(server_id="oauth-server", oauth_credentials=credentials)
+    with patch.object(service, "load_catalog", AsyncMock(return_value=fake_catalog)):
+        db = MagicMock()
+        db.execute.return_value.scalar_one_or_none.return_value = None
+        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
+
+        def mock_refresh(obj):
+            obj.id = "test-id"
+            obj.created_at = now
+            obj.updated_at = now
+            obj.reachable = False
+
+        db.refresh = MagicMock(side_effect=mock_refresh)
+        with patch("mcpgateway.services.catalog_service.select"), patch("mcpgateway.services.catalog_service.slugify", return_value="oauth-server"):
+            await service.register_catalog_server("oauth-server", request, db, created_by="u@x.com", owner_email="u@x.com", token_teams=None)

+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_register_oauth_skips_catalog_issuer_when_dcr_unsupported(service):
+    """supports_dcr: false and no client_id -> catalog issuer is not applied (no DCR attempt)."""
+    catalog_oauth = {"issuer": "https://issuer.example.com", "authorization_url": "https://issuer.example.com/authorize", "token_url": "https://issuer.example.com/token", "supports_dcr": False}
+    config = await _register_oauth_with_catalog(service, catalog_oauth, {"scopes": ["read"]})
+    assert "issuer" not in config
+    assert config["authorization_url"] == "https://issuer.example.com/authorize"
+    assert config["token_url"] == "https://issuer.example.com/token"
+
+    config = await _register_oauth_with_catalog(service, catalog_oauth, {"client_id": "abc"})
+    assert config["issuer"] == "https://issuer.example.com"
+

+    assert "token_url" not in config

+    assert config["authorization_url"] == "https://issuer.example.com/authorize"
